payload.note: StartOfRefresh objectives are checked at the start of Refresh — before retrieve, draw missions, advance-time, recruit/build, and deploy. If you satisfy the condition only after deploys (e.g. fresh units landed in Rebel-loyalty systems), the objective stays in hand and will be re-checked at the next Refresh.

pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — queued
pendingNotices.details: This resolves at the END of the Command phase, once both players have passed. You'll then choose to either move up to 5 units from one system to the Rebel Base (ignoring adjacency) or establish a new Rebel Base.

pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 1 unit from Ryloth into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Ryloth remains a possible base location.

pendingNotices.title: Death Star Plans — no fighter left to make the run
pendingNotices.details: Death Star Plans needs at least 1 of your FIGHTERS (X-Wing, Y-Wing or U-Wing) still alive when the space battle step ends. Capital ships don't qualify, however many survive, and destroying the Death Star's escorts doesn't help if your fighters die doing it. The card stays in your hand — the window is re-checked after the space step of every round.
